questions.stem: Explain why two emmetropic eyes can have different axial lengths and different optical powers. Use the concept of emmetropization.
questions.explanation: Emmetropia depends on a match, not a single universal dimension. A longer eye has a lower retinal vergence demand and can remain emmetropic if its optical components are correspondingly weaker. Emmetropization is the developmental coordination that tends to produce this match.
